title: Cairn AI Framework Used in Autonomous Zero-Day Exploitation
summary: Amazon uncovered AI-powered attacks on universities, where autonomous agents found a zero-day and gained root access without human guidance. Amazon’s threat intelligence team found a Chinese-nexus actor running Cairn, an open-source AI pentesting framework, with one instruction for the agents: obtain shell access. No human chose the next step after...
advisory: Review logs and e-commerce infrastructure for exposure to this vector.
